primary_goal: Reproduce and improve the original Figure 3C PPC recent-tone-context/prevalence decoding result for all 17 source recording sessions, six tones and both laser OFF/ON conditions, using the original per-session 70/30 training/held-trial support. Reproduction assesses native predictions/AUCs and original decoding controls. Improvement means meaningful predictive-AUC gain over the qualified author decoder under identical original support. Biological perturbation effects and Figure 3G remain separately versioned context.
primary_scope: Explicit versioned selection: original Figure 3C PPC neural decoding of recent-tone context/prevalence, all 17 source sessions, six tones and both laser conditions, with source-native held-trial probabilities/AUCs and indispensable shuffled-label control. Both outcomes address this original computational result. Biological laser-condition effects and Figure 3G remain retained context, not superiority targets.
retained_secondary_scope: Preserve prior Figure 3C/3G biological-contrast definitions and source-recovery evidence at the exact base commit and unchanged canonical contracts. Biological ON/OFF effects, directions and P values are context, not values to maximize. Existing exposed-label probability-MAE is calibration, not predictive performance. No whole-paper or current-SOTA claim follows.

common_original_anchors.aggregation: Keep the complete original 17-session x 2-condition AUC panel, per-trial probabilities/support and source shuffled-label comparator, preserving OFF/ON pairing, animal nesting and six-tone support. No cross-condition scalar, favorable session subset or perturbation-difference magnitude becomes the primary score.

remaining_source_limits: Authenticate all 17 Figure 3C figure-point/session/animal joins, both conditions and complete six-tone support, including the four-animal claim/Table S1 discrepancy.

Recover source input order, exact original trial partitions, R/package/RNG versions, caret adaptive-CV/random-search defaults, training controls and XGBoost settings. Seed 101 is already source-supported.
Recover published full-precision 34-cell AUC and held-trial prediction vectors and source-equivalent strongest relevant author rerun provenance; no original numeric baseline is established.

Resolve original source-auto pROC levels/orientation and predictive interpretation before evaluator selection. Fixed-positive or corrected AUC is a separate protocol unless exact source equivalence is demonstrated.
Authenticate original PPC feature membership, upstream 1.5-second/20-ms construction, zero-fill semantics and original training-label shuffle procedure/support/output identities.

Justify numerical reproduction tolerance and meaningful full-panel AUC improvement/uncertainty with paired held trials, laser conditions and animal nesting. Do not maximize biological differences or significance.

Implement protected original-trial fitting/evaluation with independent granular verification, matched information conditions and cumulative budgets; historical exposed-label probability reconstruction is not predictive benchmarking.

Existing improvement/v1 admits one scalar candidate/published value. This vector endpoint requires future full-panel comparison/admission support; do not invent a global mean/win count. Coordinated primary-directory/central bindings remain pending.
